messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: postgres-connection-pool-exhaustion in us-east-1. Severity: P1. Triggered by 95th percentile connection usage > 98%
PagerDuty: Pager duty alert fired for oncall team. Incident: INC-2026-0421.
Evan: Seeing a spike in PG active connections, app side errors `pq: sorry, too many clients`. Confirming impact — are any external customers reporting errors?
Priya: Yes Sentry shows a hop in 5xxs from inference-api, about ~3% of requests failing with 503s. A few customers reported degraded latency via support.
Jorge: Oncall here. I'll ack the pager. @Evan @Priya headcount?
PagerDuty: evan acknowledged the incident.
Evan: I can jump in now, switching Slack to incident channel.
Priya: I'm on DB. Running `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle';` shows ~950 active connections, limit is 1000. Background workers also ramped.
Jorge: Which service is creating the spike? Querying `pg_stat_activity` shows many connections from inference-runtime (svc-infer), many in idle-in-transaction and some in executing `COPY`?
Carol: I'm looking at Prometheus. Inference-runtime outgoing QPS jumped 3x after a background re-roll earlier. There was a rollout ~10m ago to canary. Could be a leak.
Evan: Mitigation plan: 1) Add emergency connection ceiling relief on the proxy (pgbouncer) -> increase max_client_conn. 2) Scale out read replicas or shift some traffic. 3) Kill stuck queries older than 120s. 4) Revert canary if necessary.
Priya: I can SSH to primary and kill longest queries. Will annotate which ones.
Jorge: I'm going to flip routing to route edge traffic away from the canary pool (traffic-split -> 0%). Also will disable autoscale trigger temporarily.
Priya: Running: 
```
SELECT pid, usename, application_name, state, now() - query_start AS duration, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Found ~60 sessions in `idle in transaction` from svc-infer-connector, some > 5m. Killing top offenders now.
Priya: Killed 12 pids. Connection count dropped to ~870. Errors in app spike for a minute, now falling.
Evan: Nice. Can we temporarily increase pgbouncer pool size? Carol, can you change pgbouncer config on the pooler fleet?
Carol: Pushing a config bump to pgbouncer: `max_client_conn = 2000` and raising pool_size for inference pool. Rolling through 6 hosts now.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: config change applied to 6/6 poolers.
Jorge: Noted. I'm also scaling inference-runtime deployment by +3 replicas to reduce per-rep connection pressure.
Evan: We're seeing 5xxs drop to 0.6% now. Latency still elevated but trending down. Any database-level errors like locks?
Priya: No heavy locks. Looks primarily connection exhaustion and a few long-running analytic jobs kicked off by nightly ingest that coincided with the canary. Those ingest jobs should be running on a dedicated replica — investigating why they hit primary.
Jorge: Rollout to canary shows a misconfigured connection leak: the new connector isn't returning connections under some error paths. I've disabled the canary and reverted to stable.
Evan: Good. After revert, connection usage stabilized around 650. Carol, can you scale down pgbouncer bump once stable? We don't want to leave higher limits for long.
Carol: Will hold for 30m to ensure stability, then revert.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Jorge, Evan. Escalation to DB lead if not resolved in 30m.
Evan: Assigning action items: Priya to follow up on why ingest hit primary (root cause), Jorge to validate connector fix and add integration test to ensure connections are released, Carol to revert pgbouncer config after 30m, Evan to draft incident summary for postmortem.
Priya: Noted. Creating thread in #postmortems after stabilizing.
Jorge: Adding hotfix to runtime to add defensive connection timeouts. Will open PR and tag @Evan for review.
Evan: Traffic and errors back to normal for the last 10 minutes. I'm going to demote severity to P2 and cancel PD escalations. Agree?
Carol: Agree. All metrics look good in us-east-1, read replicas healthy.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0421 updated: status -> acknowledged -> in_progress -> mitigated (pending review).
Evan: Great work team. After action items complete, let's run a chaos test against connection saturation cases in staging and add alerting to detect unusual increases in idle-in-transaction.
Priya: Will also add alert for large spikes in `idle in transaction` and an automated job to surface long-running `idle in transaction` sessions older than 60s.
Jorge: I'll coordinate with SRE QA to add integration test and ensure canary gating checks for connection usage regressions.
Carol: Leaving monitoring on watch for 45m, will revert pgbouncer in 30m unless we see a regression.
Evan: Thanks all — closing pager once pgbouncer revert confirmed.
Priya: Revert applied, metrics stable. I'll create postmortem draft and link to this thread.
Jorge: PR for fix is up: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123 (adds ensureRelease in connector).
Evan: Logging follow-up items in the incident board. Good job. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0421 marked mitigated by Evan.
Carol: Marking channel as clean.
Evan: Closing thread.
